package fixture

// A child `go` started through pkg/subproc with no environment of its own: the same
// hole as exec.Command("go", ...), reached through the door every child now goes through.
// This fixture is what the class test must refuse.

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/mas-bandwidth/nova-tools/pkg/subproc"
)

func listDeps(dir string) ([]byte, error) {
	cmd, cancel := subproc.Command(context.Background(), subproc.Go, "go", "list", "-deps", "./...")
	defer cancel()
	cmd.Dir = dir
	return cmd.Output()
}
